ValidationRule.description: 仕様: Accounting 第6.2節。スロットと実勘定科目の勘定区分を一致させる。既存割当は残す。
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(SlotKey__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(Account__c)), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(SlotKey__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c)), CASE( TEXT(SlotKey__c), "AccountsReceivable", "Asset", "ContractAsset", "Asset", "Cash", "Asset", "DeferredRevenue", "Liability", "TaxPayable", "Liability", "UnappliedCash", "Liability", "SuspensePayment", "Asset", "Revenue", "Revenue", "FxGain", "Revenue", "FxLoss", "Expense", "OtherIncome", "Revenue", "OtherExpense", "Expense", "UNKNOWN" ) <> TEXT(Account__r.AccountType__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: スロットと科目の勘定区分が一致していません。
